Not to be a downer, but what if the Block is also Unity's final resting place? It's known that she doesn't make it out alive by the time the Freedom Six are formed, and even hinted that she was dead long before. With the span of time between the Freedom Five to the Freedom Six being maybe ten years, if I'm generous, would it be completely crazed to think Unity was captured in one attempt against the changing Legacy by the gigantic anti-mutant organization that may or may not have Legacy's aid as a sure-fure way to keep his friends away from his plans? And then, due to their evil-ness, they tested and/or experimented on the young girl for a year or two before accidentally - or purposefully - killing her, leaving her mind to be implanted in some metal that eventually formed the new-fangled Unity we will soon know? If such, then I would not like to cross anyone that continues to support The Block as a positive tool for the world.

 

I'm sad now.
